title: Until the portal accepts part sales the rest of Story 8 is live
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with BOTH Part sales -> Create & Edit AND Invoicing & payments -> Create & Edit, on the build under test.
  2. A customer to sell to exists; if none does, create one first: Customers -> New Customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair").
  3. A part sale in Estimate, Approved or Complete status. Seed it: Part Sales -> New Part Sale, select the customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair"), add a part (Add Part), and open the Finance tab.
  4. The Customer Portal does not yet accept part sales (the standing Open Question, SV-10261).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Create Deposit dialog and confirm Collect in Portal shows the portal's reason and the portal handoff is unreachable.
  2. Confirm every other Add Deposit / Record Deposit behaviour works.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • While the portal does not accept part sales, the portal handoff is unreachable and Collect in Portal shows the portal's reason; every other requirement in Story 8 is live.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10269 (Take a deposit on a part sale); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 8; design canvas boards S8_*; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-N4: “Until the Customer Portal accepts part sales, S8-R8 and S8-R11 are unreachable and the action shows the portal's reason. Every other requirement in this story is live”
